comment: The contract cases of the generator (binding G-5): each case calls its member once with the arguments that it names by their parameter names, each json_value written as {kind, value}. A case without raises succeeds; raises names the kind of the failure. The rules themselves are tested by the shared fixtures of tests/fixtures.
